exact_statement: Version7 retains the version6 signed entropy sector and mixed JS telescope at its original scope and adds prescribed-profile reference transport. For every independent Boolean controller a and fully shared Boolean sources G,H on finite uniform cubes, with c=(1-a)/2, p=Ec, f=(1-c)G+cH, supply normalized source spectral references Rg,Rh positive on their true supports. At every physical history inherit each source reference through its own actual-phase pair-erasure/outcome channel for DATA queries and keep it fixed for CONTROL queries. Put q=(1-p)Pg+pPh, r=(1-p)Rg+pRh and prescribe Rf(U,t)=r(t)Pf(U,t)/q(t) on positive q rows, assigning all off-target row mass to U=empty. Write Df=D(q||r), W=(1-p)D(Pg||Rg)+pD(Ph||Rh), Z=W-Df>=0, A_v=W_v-E W_child>=0, sigma_v=E Df_child-Df_v. For EVERY finite adaptive mixed physical stopping tree, sum reach*sigma+sum reach*A+E Z_leaf=Z_root. The complete nonnegative entropy-decrement path cost plus both full terminal cross-entropies is H(f_root)+E Df_leaf <= H(f_root)+W_root = weighted original source CE+J_root+L_root. The erasure path cost is smaller. If Rg=Rh at root then Z_root=J_root exactly; all-control revelation attains sum reach*sigma=J_root, with no renewal even though inherited source references may differ. Relative to actual inherited output references, raw reset kappa_v=sigma_v+E_fv+O_fv, so only net reset after those actual erasure/outcome refunds is charged to Z. Old debit b requires original earmark U-b to cover the displayed full root allowance. Conditional on source CE rates Lg,Lh and the stated v5 surcharge premise Pi<=M*gamma*I(a)+(V/2)I(GH), the full payment is <=max(M,Lg+2p,Lh+2(1-p))*I(f). No payment for independently prescribed canonical targets or universal source certificate is asserted.
